recipe.visualDefinition: A satirical, underground comic-style illustration featuring a disheveled, anthropomorphic character in a bathrobe holding a weapon, surrounded by bullet holes and bold, dripping hand-lettered typography on a clean white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Character on the left balancing heavy text block on the right
Dripping red title text contrasting with blue secondary headers
Scattered bullet holes creating a diagonal visual path across the frame
coreInvariants: Dripping liquid effect on primary display text
Stippled texture for skin/fur and bathrobe fabric

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body character occupies the left third of the frame, scaled to nearly the full height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, red, dripping title text in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the character's face, moves up to the title, then zig-zags down through the bullet holes to the tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space in the center and background to emphasize the chaotic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White background for high clarity and contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red with black outlines for the primary title and artist names.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted blue for secondary headers and title outlines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red text against low-saturation earthy tones in the character illustration.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight, rounded sans-serif with irregular baselines
letterConstructionRules: Thick black outlines with offset color fills
Variable letter sizing to create a 'bouncing' rhythm
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters G and R featuring elongated, curved tails
O's rendered as slightly squashed circles

composition.relationshipToImage: layered over background, adjacent to character

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A chaotic, dripping display face paired with a cleaner, rounded sans-serif for legibility in the list.
graphicDevices: Bullet holes with radial impact lines

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Illustrate a disheveled anthropomorphic character in a dark grey bathrobe on a white background. Add scattered bullet holes with impact marks around the character.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, arched, dripping red lettering with thick black outlines in the top right. Below it, add a list of text in alternating blue and red rounded bold sans-serif, right-aligned.

verificationChecks: Does the title text have a dripping liquid effect?
Is the character outlined in heavy black ink?
Are there bullet holes scattered across the composition?
Is the text right-aligned and color-coded?

adjustableVariables: Number and placement of bullet holes
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the drips look like liquid, not just spikes.
Check that the character's stippled texture is visible.
Verify the blue and red text colors are distinct.
Confirm the bullet holes have 'impact' lines.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a gritty, stippled cartoon character with arched, dripping display type and a right-aligned list of secondary information to create a satirical media cover.
